JOINT PUBLIC HEARING FOR APPROVAL OF THE DISPOSITION AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION AND JASMINE REAL ESTATE INVESTMENTS, LLC
It is recommended that the City Council and Commission hold a joint public hearing and take public testimony on the Disposition and Development Agreement. Subsequent to the public hearing, it is recommended that the City Council and Commission adopt the attached Resolutions approving the Disposition and Development Agreement between the Commission and Jasmine Real Estate Investments, LLC.

CONSIDERATION OF MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT NO. 133 ("MCA-133") - ADOPTION OF ZONING REGULATIONS PERTAINING TO AUTOMOBILE DEALERSHIPS IN THE C-2 (GENERAL COMMERCIAL) ZONE
The Planning Commission recommends that the City Council:
1) Approve and adopt the Negative Declaration;
2) Waive reading of Ordinance No. 10-___ and read by title only; and
3) Introduce Ordinance No. 10-___, An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente Adding Section 10.08.890 and Subsection (34) to Section 10.60.020 and Amending Subsection (6) of Section 10.40.010 of Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code Pertaining to Zoning Regulations of Automobile Dealerships in the C-2 (General Commercial) Zone Within the City.

CONSIDERATION OF URGENCY ORDINANCE AND NON-URGENCY ORDINANCES ADOPTING BY RERERENCE 2010 LOS ANGELES COUNTY BUILDING, FIRE AND OTHER CODES
Staff recommends that the City Council:1) Waive the reading of Urgency Ordinance and read by title only; 2) Introduce and Adopt Urgency Ordinance- An Urgency Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente Adopting by Reference, Pursuant to Government Code Section 50022.2, Title 26 of Los Angeles County Building Code, Incorporating by Reference California Building Code 2010 Edition; Title 27 of Los Angeles County Electrical Code, Incorporating by Reference California Electrical Code 2010 Edition; Title 28 of Los Angeles County Plumbing Code, Incorporating by Reference California Plumbing Code 2010 Edition; Title 29 of Los Angeles County Mechanical Code, Incorporating by Reference California Mechanical Code 2010 Edition; Title 30 of Los Angeles County Residential Code, Incorporating by Reference California Residential Code 2010 Edition; Title 31 of Los Angeles County Green Building Standards Code, Incorporating by Reference California Green Building Code 2010 Edition; Title 32 of Los Angeles County Fire Code, Incorporating by Reference California Fire Code 2010 Edition and Making Required Findings For Same; 3) Waive the reading of Non-Urgency Ordinance and read by title only; 4) Introduce Non-Urgency Ordinance - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente Adopting by Reference, Pursuant to Government Code Section 50022.22, Title 26 of Los Angeles County Building Code, Incorporating by Reference California Building Code 2010 Edition; Title 27 of Los Angeles County Electrical Code, Incorporating by Reference California Electrical Code 2010 Edition; Title 28 of Los Angeles County Plumbing Code, Incorporating by Reference California Plumbing Code 2010 Edition; Title 29 of Los Angeles County Mechanical Code, Incorporating by Reference California Mechanical Code 2010 Edition; Title 30 of Los Angeles County Residential Code, Incorporating by Reference California Residential Code 2010 Edition; Title 31 of Los Angeles County Green Building Standards Code, Incorporating by Reference California Green Building Code 2010 Edition; Title 32 of Los Angeles County Fire Code, Incorporating by Reference California Fire Code 2010 Edition and Making Required Findings For Same; 5) Schedule a public hearing on the adoption of the Non-Urgency Ordinance for January 11, 2011; 6) Approve and adopt the Notice of Exemption

CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.

It is recommended that the City Council approve the revised agreement with the Hacienda-La Puente Unified School District and authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement on its behalf.
CC.E-1 Agreement with HLPUSD for Nature Center- report
CC.E-1 Agreement with HLPUSD for Nature Center - Attach A
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF REJECTION ALL PROPOSALS AND TO RE-SOLICIT PROPOSALS FOR AN EXCLUSIVE FRANCHISE TO PROVIDE TAXICAB SERVICE WITHIN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) reject all taxicab franchise proposals, 2) direct Staff to re-advertise the Request for Proposals in the San Gabriel Valley Tribune, Los Angeles Times, and Highlander, and 3) directly invite proposals from the firms that had previously submitted proposals or expressed interest in providing taxicab services in the past.
